name: Failed Module initialization exposes no partial state and does not retry

applicability.reason: Supported. C018 forbids exposing a partially initialized Module, marks a failed one failed FOR THAT LOAD ATTEMPT, forbids an automatic retry, and requires an explicit reload before another attempt. The first half already held - a Module whose initializer raises withdraws its name, so nothing partial is visible - but the load then failed outright, so no runtime survived to be asked and the other two halves had no surface. A failed Module is now RETAINED as failed, `Reflection::Package.module_status` reports failed, initialized or absent so a Module that never existed stays distinguishable from one that raised, and `Reflection::Package.reload` is the explicit retry. Accessing the failed Module twice answers failed both times, which is the no-automatic-retry half, and only the reload clears it. The shared load path continues past a failure ONLY for a package whose sources observe that state, so the 54 vectors already running through it keep failing the whole load as before.
